text.p: These are the leading stories in the Moroccan press on Friday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- King Hassan presides over religious ceremony to mark Prophet Mohammad's birthday.
- Privatisation and finance ministers chair meeting in Spain over ways to attract foreign investment for Morocco.
- More cocaine seized in the coastal city of Safi.
- King Hassan pardons 661 prisoners on Prophet Mohammad birthday.
- Turnover of highway utility increases to 140 million dirhams ($14.4 million), up 20 percent in 1996 compared with the previous year.
- Arab fund grants Morocco $98.9 million to build two dams southeast of Rabat.
- More than 263,700 expatriates bound for Morocco transited through the Spanish town of Algeciras since mid-June.
